annotations.title: Gemini 3.8 Live Native Audio-to-Audio Conversational Processor

description: Processes real-time conversational dialog turns with native acoustic emotion, interruption handling, and paralinguistic cue comprehension via Gemini 3.8 Live. Use when handling interactive voice-agent dialog turns that require tone and turn-taking awareness; for performing one-way text-to-speech readout of a static text string, use synthesize_gemini_speech_audio instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('response_tone' defaults to 'direct_peer'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: Conversational audio transcript or dialog turn payload to process.

response_tone.description: Target paralinguistic delivery style; defaults to 'direct_peer' when omitted.

name: process_live_audio_dialogue

output.description: Conversational response turn and paralinguistic cues.

success.description: True when live dialog turn processing succeeded.

turn_complete.description: True when the response turn is finalized.
